curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: model subtraction as taking away using concrete objects

mission.title: model subtraction as taking away using concrete objects

interactions.prompt: There are 3 bananas. One banana goes into the basket. How many bananas stay on the mat?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Start with 3. Take 1 away. 2 bananas stay.
interactions.retryHint: Point to the banana that went away. Now count the bananas still on the mat.

interactions.prompt: Start with 5 bottle tops. Move 2 to the away box. Show how many stay.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the minus button two times, then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: Great! 5 bottle tops take away 2 leaves 3.
interactions.retryHint: Begin at 5. Count back two steps: 4, then 3.

interactions.prompt: Six toy cars are ready. Two drive away. Show the cars that are left.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap one less for each car that drives away, then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: Well done! 6 take away 2 leaves 4 cars.
interactions.retryHint: Take away one car: 5. Take away one more: 4.

interactions.prompt: Asha has 8 mangoes. She gives 3 mangoes to her friends. How many mangoes does Asha have now?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Asha starts with 8. After 3 go away, 5 mangoes stay.
interactions.retryHint: Cover the 3 mangoes given away. Count only the mangoes left.

interactions.prompt: At the class garden, 9 seedlings are in a tray. Plant 4 seedlings. Show the seedlings still in the tray.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap one less four times for the planted seedlings, then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: You did it! 9 seedlings take away 4 leaves 5 in the tray.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. There are 12 shells. Put 5 shells in the collection bag. How many shells stay on the sand?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap one less five times, then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! 12 shells take away 5 leaves 7 shells.
interactions.retryHint: Start at 12 and count back five steps: 11, 10, 9, 8, 7.
